reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all464 original lines, M1–M4, MP2–MP13/UIE notes, every stopped/resumed/merged/post-merge record, E1–E3 and A1–A4/domain-law checks. The pre-merge live-worktree-copy sentence is already superseded by the folded shared-checkpoint/plan-reconciliation entry. No old PID, reservation, missing-branch rulebook, staged deletion or worktree path is current state or an instruction to resume/merge/clean. Current PROJECT/AD36/AD42/AD43 and later engine owners govern selected work.

F2: M1 cycle break and M2 two-domain/equality tests prove their selected before/after routes and absent-slice save compatibility at historical inputs, not full-game independence. M3 first stopped on readiness, then B3 uncovered native load's lost materialRef; slice-only roundtrip tests had missed the native consumer. B4's later gather/craft/drink/recovery control/native-use/Back/Esc/save/reload/Export/literal Import and old-save path supersedes stopped/unrebuilt text at that bundle. Preserve failing controls and3TODOs separately from2045 passes. Readiness refresh and ownsItemKey hooks are generic seams, not proof every registry domain/panel adopted them.

F3: The reported M1/M2 saved-envelope comparison has two named availability-template differences, not byte equality of all fields. One lost-output failed lane run remains unexplained beside later passes. The approved fast-forward/shared-WIP reconciliation preserves both behavior sets, but its2065pass/3fail/3TODO is not a clean full suite; failure controls were attributed to matching pre-merge WIP. Shared-shell route initially blocked M3 and a later scoped post-merge harness pass closes that route at its snapshot. Duplicate legitimate crafting_detail instances require scoped selectors, not deletion. The earlier preserve-validator-after-registry suggestion differs from the actual before-registry merge note; treat the latter as reported historical outcome, not proof that arbitrary validator reorder is safe.

F4: M4 lamp is a real stock/light/clock/reading/combat/exploration consumer with quote/commit/rollback, support-loss and old-save cases, not another displayed meter. E1 missing registry ticks on travel, E2 trade-exit state and E3 fake-DOM snapshot problem were distinct found/fixed causes; real browser was not affected by E3. Headless fresh-save journey differs from fixture-seeded1920 browser smoke and exact-element DOM-dispatched clicks; neither proves pointer interaction or natural acquisition/pacing. Keep2243/2243 and partial smoke resource404 precisely, plus oil-state inspection and old script gaps. 1366 evidence is historical and not today's desktop target.

F5: The source's240-minute/40-light/20-minute notice/price/reading factors remain prototype dials, not universal light laws or accepted balancing. Actual living gear and lamp are different supplied means; unknown dose can work before its effect is known. One preparation replacing another is the inspected narrow owner policy, not universal combined-remedy law. Combat/reading light readers and transaction semantics are distinct from modelled eyesight/injury. The Tools-port borrowing concern is later addressed by ENGINE_EXPANSION's P2 independent lamp/direct-composition receipt, read here at its exact documented scope; it does not establish whole-game reentrancy. Generic framework, port-bag or exception proposals remain conditional. No current code, build, browser/image, private save, worker, migration, deletion, commit, push or source acquisition occurred.

reviews.classification: full chronological implementation checkpoint review; recovered native paths and distinct publication/proof scopes
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all122 original lines: MF1–MF7, MF14–MF19, MF26–MF34, staged ownership, failures, fonts/route/persistence and publication handoff. Opening current-publication correction already supersedes the original no-commit/no-push/pending-adoption boundary for the historical released scope. Today's PROJECT/release owner governs later installed state; October22 Electron v0.6-72af84cf8e66 is not freshly checked current app. No linked report, JSON proof, private diagnostics, preview PID or underlying mod source was newly inspected.

F2: Preserve seven adaptations as scoped original mechanisms and source mappings, not imported Minecraft code/assets or a whole settlement simulation. Ordered composable techniques, shared real capacity, assigned-helper custody, discovery versus material truth, resource-fed garden, ceramic stages and requests/deliveries have distinct consumers and failure semantics. Earlier-learning/access/stock seeding is explicit: fourteen groups/five persistence states and actual14/21px repair prove the chosen fixture, not a wholly natural opening or all seven mods. The early preview's guard/smoke is separate from later primary generated-game delivery; a remembered localhost/PID is not a currently live handle or runnable candidate.

F3: MF14–MF19 adds actual retained wet/dry targets, charcoal, fed garden, observed shortcut, recoverable finite wisp orders and handcart custody/reservation/priority/refund. Its native Shack action replaces the earlier More-panels-only discovery route. The same-line host port is still a source integration, despite no main line growth. Exact19groups/eight persistence states,2486/2486 and font/header follow-up are attributed dated evidence, not renewed proof of today's composition. No allowlist exception and no new clock/save writer do not mean absence of persistent semantic change.

F4: MF26–MF34 distinguish in-flight goods/destination capacity/return leg, rain/exposure/consecutive work, real residence rights and room/rota support, and partial top-ups. Depot inventory is not immediate player custody. Missing weather history earns no invented drying; new wet pieces cannot inherit prior time. A shift ending need not void completed paid work. Native action-host refresh failure and own-node lifecycle repair retain their separate history. First unconstrained suite lacked completion, then2504/2504 bounded candidate run and later2505/2505 final candidate are different results. Focused29/29 and23/23 only cover their consumers; reused unchanged evidence does not cover unrelated later home edits.

F5: Final14 native groups/seven exact persistence states/primary installed-font smoke and source/output parity are technical delivery of that candidate; publication7df5a7df7 and combined adoption are separate attributed later handoffs. Natural pacing/human judgment remain optional feedback under AD42, not reasons to relaunch the released writer. Old ownership releases/permissions do not grant new worker, app-swap, cleanup, publication or push authority. Current ACR7/8/10/11 and world-local MR/rights owners preserve phase costs, clocks, worker support and committed terms without all-world rollout. No runtime, installed app, browser/image, private save, acquisition, worker/message, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.

folds.body: The full [modular checkpoint B571 review](../gm/dispatch/modular-seams-2026-10-16/CHECKPOINT.md#content-reconciliation-b571-recovered-native-consumers-and-later-seams) reads the original M3 stop alongside B4, approved merge/post-merge and M4. Registry-slice roundtrips initially missed native material-key restoration; later native gather/craft/use/reload proof is the scoped correction, not a new test run here. The envelope comparison names two availability differences and an unexplained lost-output run, so do not describe it as perfect byte parity or three clean attempts. M4's lamp has real stock/light/clock/reading/exploration consumers; headless journey and fixture-seeded DOM-click browser smoke retain different scopes. Its early Tools-port borrowing is later addressed by ENGINE_EXPANSION's P2 independent-lamp/direct-composition receipt, not proof of whole-engine independence. Preserve original failures, retained shared-WIP boundaries, prototype numeric dials and optional human review; no current runtime, registry rewrite or fresh gameplay proof is added.
